title: Qualification sweep on the supported matrix and demonstrated fixes
summary: Runs the complete qualification of release conditions 1–9 on HEAD — locally (Arch, parity/regression, static analysis, type coverage, full suite on PHP 8.4 and PHP 8.3, three DB lanes, engines, replica, Redis, extended, consumer archives) and in GitHub Actions on origin feat/1.0-candidate (the full PHP 8.3–8.5 × Laravel 11–13 × lowest/stable matrix, DB lanes, coverage, static analysis, style, Zizmor, CodeQL, nightly) — and fixes every failure it demonstrates until everything is green.
why: Conditions 1–9 stay claims until one run on one tree shows them. The last pushed commit b6cbaf59 (P2 exit) is red in CI: Tests jobs P8.3/P8.4 × L11 × lowest/stable fail `Tests\Feature\Testing\ContractKitRegressionTest` (rowCounts with table prefix / attached database / own database), `ConsumerParticipantContractTest` and `JournalParticipantContractTest` ('participant runs again on a retry and keeps only the committed attempt'), and `NegativeFixturesTest` (hook and participant suites); none of the P3 commits ran in CI; on 2026-10-11 PHP 8.3 broke SQLite snapshot reads (since then `StorageReadSession::transactionOpen()` probes). Hard risks: a 'fix' that changes a frozen format or supported signature (stop rule), a test weakened to get green, CI and local runs on different trees.

include: Local runs V1–V12 on one committed HEAD; results in `plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/qualification.md` (sha, command, exit, counts, duration, log under `plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/logs/`)

GitHub Actions: push HEAD to origin `feat/1.0-candidate` (owner gate CI-PUSH), dispatch `tests-nightly.yml` on it, wait for Tests, Static Analysis, Code Style, Zizmor, CodeQL and Tests (nightly); record `ci-runs-<sha>.json`

Fix every demonstrated failure (p4-execution#conventions items 1–2), starting with the Laravel 11 failures listed in `why`: reproduce locally where possible (a Laravel 11 install needs an owner-run `composer update` with `laravel/framework:11.*`, `orchestra/testbench:^9.0`; otherwise read the CI log with `gh api …/jobs/<id>/logs`), one commit per fix, row in `fixes.md`; push again and repeat until the whole V-list is green on one sha
If the PHP 8.3 SQLite read-session failure reappears, fix it inside the internal `Storage\Internal\StorageReadSession` with a test that the CI 8.3 jobs run
exclude: New checks or workflow restructuring (P4.3–P4.5), except a workflow fix a failing job demonstrates
Any change behind the stop rule without the owner

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
The amended release conditions and which evidence this item contributes
Original ten conditions and CI rules; read together with p4-execution#gate (amended rows win)
Invariant ids, their checks and statuses
Cutting a release, step 1: the qualification list the release expects
CI matrix, DB lanes, replica, Redis, coverage, consumer job
Nightly depth (extended, --full lanes); owner WIP — read only

task_files.note: only tests of demonstrated fixes; never weaken

rules: Do not stage, revert or overwrite the owner's uncommitted files (p4-execution#conventions item 6); commit only the item's paths.
Every acceptance run is on the committed HEAD that CI also ran; if a fix lands, re-run the affected local checks and CI on the new sha and keep only the final sha's evidence as acceptance.
Ask for the CI-PUSH grant before the first push and record it with `plan.py grant`.
guidance: Start the long runs detached (`setsid nohup … &`), MySQL/MariaDB parallel lanes alone; while they run, push and read CI. Triage each failure: environment (missing service, port) → fix the environment, not the code; version-specific framework behavior (Laravel 11 schema builder, testbench 9 lifecycle) → fix the code or the test fixture so the behavior is identical on every supported version, never skip a version; flaky (passes on rerun) → run it 20× locally, a reproducible flake is a defect. Write each failure into fixes.md before fixing it.

validation.cmd: php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression --fail-on-skipped
composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check

validation.expect: exit 0, or vendor needs PHP >= 8.4 (recorded; CI 8.3 jobs are the evidence)

export PGSQL_PORT=25432 MYSQL_PORT=23306 MARIADB_PORT=23307 && composer test:db -- pgsql --engines && composer test:db -- mysql --engines && composer test:db -- mariadb --engines
composer test:replica && composer test:redis && composer test:extended
bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh && bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh --with-filament && bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh core-only
validation.expect: exit 0 for full, with-filament and core-only archives

validation.cmd: SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && OUT=plans/2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION/artifacts/evidence/P4/ci-runs-$SHA.json && gh run list --commit "$SHA" --limit 100 --json databaseId,workflowName,event,headSha,status,conclusion,url > "$OUT" && python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); need=set(sys.argv[2].split(",")); ok={x["workflowName"] for x in r if x["conclusion"]=="success"}; bad=[x for x in r if x["workflowName"] in need and x["conclusion"]!="success"]; sys.exit(0 if need<=ok and not bad else 1)' "$OUT" "Tests,Static Analysis,Code Style,Zizmor,CodeQL,Tests (nightly)"
validation.expect: exit 0: every required workflow succeeded on HEAD

deliverables: qualification.md and ci-runs-<sha>.json for one green sha

authority.scope: Push the local HEAD to origin refs/heads/feat/1.0-candidate (force-with-lease only on that branch) and dispatch tests-nightly.yml on it, to obtain GitHub Actions evidence; never main, never tags.

result.notes: Qualification sweep green on 4a429068883a2e47642cb12272445beb976081e5; five demonstrated fixes F1-F5 (zones.json, Laravel 11 row counts, Filament Htmlable label, doctor password in CI env, optimize task order).
deviations: V7 mariadb lane and V8 engines were not run locally: the owner accepted the green CI jobs as evidence; V6 cannot run on PHP 8.3 locally (vendor needs >= 8.4), CI 8.3 jobs are the evidence; Zizmor/CodeQL started by workflow_dispatch; fix commits made with path-limited git commit to keep owner WIP untouched
